buildCommand: mkdir -p public; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.png' \) ! -name 'index.html' ! -name 'gacha.html' ! -name 'api-*.js' ! -name 'bridge.js' -exec cp -t public/ {} +; if [ -d assets ]; then cp -R assets public/assets; fi; test -s public/integrated-live-demo.html && test -s public/integrated-functional-test.html && test ! -e public/index.html && test ! -e public/gacha.html && test ! -e public/api-register.js && test ! -e public/bridge.js
